note: Who is living in this archive, as decided by the kit's living_rule.py (80 or younger, no death recorded) over people.json, plus anyone the archive records as living in the field a date would occupy. Written by tools/livingflags.py and read by the layout and the person pages; tools/checkliving2.py recomputes it independently and refuses the build if the two differ. A living person is shown with their name, their relationships and their town and country, and nothing more.
